entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Happiness, joy, delight, elation; Excitement, eagerness, anticipation; Heart, pulse
entries.zh: 快乐、喜悦、欣喜、兴高采烈；兴奋、热切、期待；心脏、脉搏。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Happy, jolly, pleased, delighted, thrilled, overjoyed, elated, ecstatic; Bubbly, fizzy, lively, buzzing, animated, radiant; Eager, excited, enthusiastic
entries.zh: 快乐、愉快、高兴、欣喜、激动、喜出望外、振奋、狂喜；活泼、像汽水般欢腾、生机勃勃、兴奋不已、神采飞扬、容光焕发；急切、兴奋、热情。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Beat, raced, pounded, throbbed; Tingled, shook, trembled, shivered
entries.zh: 跳动、加速、猛跳、搏动；酥麻、摇晃、颤抖、战栗。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: On top of the world
entries.zh: 觉得幸福极了；心情好到极点

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Over the moon
entries.zh: 欣喜若狂；高兴极了

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Bubbly like a fizzy drink
entries.zh: 像汽水冒泡一样活泼欢腾

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Buzzing with excitement
entries.zh: 兴奋得浑身来劲

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Glow of happiness
entries.zh: 幸福的暖意

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Sense of elation
entries.zh: 兴高采烈的感觉

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Unbearable gurgle in his stomach
entries.zh: 胃里翻腾着几乎难以忍受的激动

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Heart pounded
entries.zh: 心脏怦怦直跳

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Pulse raced
entries.zh: 脉搏加速

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Shivered with eagerness
entries.zh: 因热切期待而发抖

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Body tingled with excitement
entries.zh: 全身因兴奋而发麻

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Hands shook with anticipation
entries.zh: 双手因期待而颤抖

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Could hardly contain his excitement
entries.zh: 几乎无法抑制兴奋

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His elation was an almost unbearable gurgle in his stomach.
entries.zh: 他欣喜若狂，胃里激动得翻腾，几乎难以承受。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was buzzing with excitement and couldn’t help breaking into a wide grin.
entries.zh: 他兴奋不已，忍不住咧嘴大笑。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She felt as if she was on top of the world and a glow of happiness spread through her.
entries.zh: 她幸福到了极点，快乐的暖意传遍全身。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His pulse was racing and he took a deep and loudly enthusiastic breath.
entries.zh: 他的脉搏飞快跳动，兴奋地大声深吸了一口气。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: With heart pounding and hands shaking, she tore open the envelope.
entries.zh: 她心怦怦直跳，双手颤抖着撕开信封。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Look, grin, smile, laughter; Mouth, lip, laughter lines
entries.zh: 神情、咧嘴笑、微笑、笑声；嘴、嘴唇、笑纹。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Wide, broad, huge, eager; Toothy, cheeky, impish, comical, humorous
entries.zh: 宽大、开怀、巨大、热切；露齿、调皮、顽皮、滑稽、幽默。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Grinned, smiled, laughed, gazed; Lit, shone, glowed; Broke, flashed, flickered
entries.zh: 咧嘴笑、微笑、笑、注视；照亮、发亮、红润；忽然绽开、一闪而过、闪现。

entries.label: Adverbs
entries.en: Happily, comically; Eagerly, excitedly, enthusiastically
entries.zh: 快乐地、滑稽地；急切地、兴奋地、热情地。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Broad grin
entries.zh: 咧嘴大笑

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives

entries.zh: 露齿而笑

entries.zh: 顽皮地咧嘴笑

entries.zh: 兴奋地咧嘴大笑

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives

entries.zh: 笑得满脸都是笑容

entries.en: Beaming smile
entries.zh: 灿烂的微笑

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Wide, gap-toothed smile
entries.zh: 张嘴笑着，露出豁牙

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Wide, eager smile
entries.zh: 热切灿烂的笑容

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Amused expression
entries.zh: 觉得有趣的神情

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Eager expression
entries.zh: 热切的表情

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Look of eager anticipation
entries.zh: 满怀热切期待的神情

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Cheeks glowed
entries.zh: 双颊泛着红光

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Gazed eagerly
entries.zh: 热切地注视

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Laughter shone in his face
entries.zh: 脸上闪着笑意

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Face lit up in a wide smile
entries.zh: 灿烂笑容使整张脸亮起来

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Grinned like a Cheshire cat
entries.zh: 像柴郡猫一样咧嘴大笑

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Broke into a broad grin
entries.zh: 忽然咧嘴大笑起来

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Flashed her a warm smile
entries.zh: 朝她露出温暖的微笑

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Flickered across his face
entries.zh: 在他脸上一闪而过

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Waggled his eyebrows comically
entries.zh: 滑稽地上下挑动眉毛

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Nibbled at her lower lip to hold back a smile
entries.zh: 轻咬下唇忍住笑

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Laughter lines at the edge of her eyes deepened
entries.zh: 眼角的笑纹加深了

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She looked up with an amused expression on her face.
entries.zh: 她抬起头，脸上带着觉得有趣的神情。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His face was lit up by a huge smile as broad as his face.
entries.zh: 他满脸大大的笑容，使整张脸亮了起来。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She was thrilled to be chosen. Her cheeks glowed with excitement and her face broke into a wide, beaming smile.
entries.zh: 被选中让她激动极了，双颊泛红，脸上绽开灿烂的笑容。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: With an impish grin, he gazed eagerly up at his mother.
entries.zh: 他顽皮地咧嘴笑着，热切地仰望母亲。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He nibbled at his lower lip to hold back the laughter that was threatening to erupt.
entries.zh: 他轻咬下唇，忍住即将爆发的笑声。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: As her face lit up in a wide grin, her eyes disappeared in deep wrinkles.
entries.zh: 她咧嘴笑得满面生辉，眼睛也挤进了深深的笑纹里。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Humour, joy, delight, laughter, amusement; Interest, eagerness, excitement; Gleam, glint
entries.zh: 幽默、快乐、欣喜、笑意、趣味；兴趣、热切、兴奋；微光、闪光。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Wide, bright, glittering
entries.zh: 睁大的、明亮的、闪闪发光的。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Shone, beamed; Laughed, danced, sparkled, twinkled
entries.zh: 发亮、放光；含笑、跳动、闪耀、闪烁。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Bright, twinkling eyes
entries.zh: 明亮闪烁的眼睛

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Wide with excitement
entries.zh: 因兴奋而睁大

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Bright with interest and excitement
entries.zh: 因兴趣和兴奋而明亮

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Gleam of humour in her eyes
entries.zh: 眼里闪着幽默的光

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Danced with laughter
entries.zh: 眼里跳动着笑意

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Twinkled with amusement
entries.zh: 饶有趣味地闪烁

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Laughter shone in her eyes
entries.zh: 眼里闪着笑意

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Shone like beams from a torch
entries.zh: 像手电筒光束一样明亮

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Burned with excitement
entries.zh: 眼里燃着兴奋的光

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Sparkled with eagerness
entries.zh: 因热切期待而闪闪发亮

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her bright eyes danced with laughter.
entries.zh: 她明亮的眼睛里跳动着笑意。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She looked down at him with laughter shining in her eyes.
entries.zh: 她垂眼看着他，眼里满是笑意。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She leaned forward, her blue eyes bright with interest and excitement.
entries.zh: 她向前倾身，蓝眼睛因兴趣和兴奋而发亮。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His eyes burned with excitement and he kept shifting from one foot to the other.
entries.zh: 他的眼睛燃着兴奋的光，双脚不断交替站立。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The delight shone from his eyes like beams from a torch and he clenched his fist and punched the air.
entries.zh: 他的眼睛像手电光束一样射出喜悦，握拳向空中一挥。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: As he burst into the room, his eyes were wide with excitement.
entries.zh: 他冲进屋时，兴奋得双眼大睁。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Even though she was not smiling, there was a glint of humour in her eyes.
entries.zh: 虽然她没笑，眼里却闪着幽默的光。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Laugh, giggle, chuckle, squeal, snort, gurgle; Shriek, guffaw, roar
entries.zh: 笑、咯咯笑、轻笑、尖叫、喷笑、咯咯声；尖叫、放声大笑、吼笑。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Low, little, big, loud, high-pitched; Hearty, manic, raucous, devilish
entries.zh: 低声、小、大、响亮、尖高；爽朗、狂热、喧闹刺耳、恶作剧般。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Giggled, chortled, snorted, laughed; Shook, trembled, cracked; Let out, stifled, blurted, exploded
entries.zh: 咯咯笑、欢笑、喷笑、笑；抖动、发颤、破音；发出、忍住、脱口而出、爆发。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Big, hearty laugh
entries.zh: 爽朗的大笑

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Loud, raucous laughter
entries.zh: 响亮喧闹的笑声

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Piercing shriek
entries.zh: 刺耳的尖叫

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Devilish roar of glee
entries.zh: 恶作剧得逞般的狂笑

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Squeal of delight
entries.zh: 喜悦的尖叫

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Stifled snort
entries.zh: 忍住的一声喷笑

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Low, wheezing chuckle
entries.zh: 低低的、带喘鸣的轻笑

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Excited gasps
entries.zh: 兴奋的喘息

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Shook with laughter
entries.zh: 笑得发抖

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Giggles bubbled at the back of her throat
entries.zh: 喉咙深处涌起咯咯笑声

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Blurted out a little laugh
entries.zh: 忍不住笑了一声

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Chortled at the look on her face
entries.zh: 看着她的表情乐得笑起来

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Let out a peel of manic laughter
entries.zh: 爆发出一阵狂笑

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Exploded into loud guffaws
entries.zh: 突然放声大笑

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Rose with excitement into a piercing squeal
entries.zh: 声音因兴奋而升高，变成尖叫

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Words tumbled over each other in a high-pitched gabble
entries.zh: 话语挤在一起，变成尖声急语

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Words came in excited gasps
entries.zh: 话语随着兴奋的喘息断续说出

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He laughed a big, hearty laugh that echoed around the room.
entries.zh: 他爽朗地哈哈大笑，笑声回荡在房间里。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She let out a squeal of delight and hopped up and down on the spot.
entries.zh: 她高兴地尖叫，站在原地上下跳。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He threw back his head and exploded into loud guffaws of laughter.
entries.zh: 他仰起头，突然放声大笑。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Kitty tried to smother her laughter, but it exploded as a snort.
entries.zh: 基蒂试图忍笑，却还是噗地笑出了声。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His voice cracked with loud, raucous laughter and tears poured down his cheeks.
entries.zh: 他笑得声音破哑，泪水沿着脸颊直流。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She pressed her lips tightly together to smother the giggles that were bubbling in the back of her throat.
entries.zh: 她紧紧抿住嘴唇，想压住喉咙里不断冒出的笑声。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Robert let out a peel of manic laughter and held his sides.
entries.zh: 罗伯特捧着肚子，爆发出一阵狂笑。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: As the laughter exploded in his throat, his shoulders shook and his body convulsed helplessly.
entries.zh: 笑声从喉咙里迸发时，他双肩抖动，全身不由自主地抽动。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Arms, hands, palms, fist
entries.zh: 手臂、手、手掌、拳头。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Skipped, hopped, jigged, pranced, danced; Leapt, sprung, jumped, bounced; Rubbed, clapped, pumped, punched, clenched; Hugged
entries.zh: 蹦跳、单脚跳、跳小步舞、雀跃、跳舞；跃起、弹起、跳、弹跳；搓、拍、上下摇动、挥拳、握紧；拥抱。

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Walked with a bounce in her step
entries.zh: 脚步轻快，带着弹跳感

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Jumped up and down
entries.zh: 上下跳跃

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Leapt in the air, screaming with excitement
entries.zh: 兴奋尖叫着跳起来

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Hopped up and down on the spot
entries.zh: 原地上下跳

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Skipped along the pavement
entries.zh: 沿人行道蹦蹦跳跳

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Jigged around the room
entries.zh: 在屋里欢快地跳小步舞

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Threw her arms around his neck
entries.zh: 双臂一下搂住他的脖子

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Clenched his fist and punched the air
entries.zh: 握拳朝空中挥舞

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Rubbed palms together with excitement
entries.zh: 兴奋地搓着手掌

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Clapped hands and squealed with delight
entries.zh: 拍手并喜悦地尖叫

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Pumped each other’s hands frantically
entries.zh: 拼命握着对方的手上下摇

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She threw her arms around his neck and shrieked with joy.
entries.zh: 她双臂搂住他的脖子，高兴地尖叫。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She dropped the phone and leapt into the air. Screaming, she pumped the air with her fist.
entries.zh: 她放下电话，跳了起来，一边尖叫一边朝空中挥拳。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He walked with a bounce in his step and a wide, eager grin on his face.
entries.zh: 他步履轻快，脸上挂着热切的大笑。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She skipped along the pavement, grinning from ear to ear.
entries.zh: 她沿人行道蹦蹦跳跳，笑得合不拢嘴。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He burst into the room, laughing madly and clapping his hands with delight.
entries.zh: 他冲进房间，笑得停不下来，高兴地拍着手。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: They were shivering with excitement and pumped each other’s hands enthusiastically.
entries.zh: 他们激动得发抖，热情地握住彼此的手使劲摇。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His whole body tingled with anticipation and he kept patting his plump hands together like an excited child.
entries.zh: 期待使他全身发麻，他像兴奋的孩子一样不停地拍着胖乎乎的双手。
